dominant_strengths: Hero render shows extraordinary craft: glass toggles, blueprint guides, and chromatic gradients communicate 'design system' through pure visual metaphor
Authentic Apple voice — SF typography, restrained nav chrome, and confident black-bar subnav feel native to developer.apple.com
Strong visceral pull from the hero composition; the rainbow slider and green toggle anchor an otherwise neutral palette with intent
dominant_weaknesses: Behavioral payoff is thin — the fold is almost entirely decorative imagery with one sentence of copy and no entry points to guidelines or resources
Headline sits awkwardly low on the hero, competing with busy graphic shapes behind it and reducing legibility despite bold weight
Subnav (Overview/What's New/Get Started…) is the only navigational scaffolding visible above the fold; information scent for a docs hub is weak
fix_priorities: Surface 2–4 concrete entry cards (Guidelines, Resources, What's New) above the fold to convert visceral interest into task flow
Lift headline higher or reserve a cleaner backdrop band so type doesn't fight the hero's render details
Add a secondary supporting line or CTA beneath the headline to give the hero a behavioral anchor, not just a mood statement
rationale.norman_balance: Heavily visceral and reflective (brand prestige, craft) at the expense of behavioral utility expected from a documentation landing.
rationale.intent_fit: Captures Apple's design-language brand beautifully but underperforms as a docs hub — it inspires before it helps you navigate.
